name: Kasuga stone lantern
notes: Depth is across the hexagon flats.
parts: hexagonal middle platform with lotus petals (chudai)
light box with deer and moon openings (hibukuro)
style: temple garden granite, rounded by weather, moss on horizontal ledges, lichen speckle
summary: Kasuga-style granite garden lantern, 1.5 m: hexagonal base, round shaft, carved light box with openings, curved roof, jewel finial.
